Why Buyers Choose Our PET Cold Cups

PET (polyethylene terephthalate) delivers glass-like transparency that makes layered drinks, boba and fruit teas look premium on the shelf. Our cups run the complete beverage caliber system — 74, 78, 90, 93, 95, 98 and 107mm — so you can standardize lids across your whole menu. Every cup is produced from FDA food-contact PET resin, and available in straight-wall, U-shape and dessert profiles. With MOQ from 1,000 pcs and full-color offset printing, both new bubble-tea brands and established chains can order at the right scale.

Frequently Asked Questions

What caliber sizes of PET cups do you produce?

We produce the full beverage caliber system: 74, 78, 90 (incl. 90U), 93, 95 (incl. 95U), 98 and 107mm, with capacities from 3oz up to 32oz. This lets you standardize one or two lid sizes across your entire drink menu.

What is the MOQ for custom printed PET cups?

Minimum order is 1,000 pieces per size for custom logo printing. Plain stock cups can ship in smaller trial quantities — contact us for details.

Are PET cups suitable for hot drinks?

No. PET is designed for cold and ambient beverages (up to about 60°C). For hot drinks choose our injection PP cups or double-wall paper cups.

Which lids fit which caliber?

Lids are matched by rim diameter: 90, 93, 95, 98mm and larger. Tell us your cup model and we supply the exact matching flat, dome, sipper or dome-dessert lid.

Can PET cups be used with sealing film machines?

Yes — our 90-98mm PET cups work with standard cup sealing machines using PET sealing film. We supply matched film rolls.
